node.title: Re: "no warnings 'uninitialized'" failing
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Have you determined which of the values it is complaining about (is it maybe RootName => undef, or $data as [LanX] pointed out)? Have you tried any alternatives, i.e. making sure you're not feeding the function undefs where you shouldn't be? Note the effect of [doc://warnings] is lexical in scope, so it won't change anything coming from inside of [mod://XML::Simple]. If that is the case, and you're feeding the function valid data, you could try the following ugly hack to suppress all warnings from inside XMLout (although it's about as ugly as using XML::Simple for XML output in the first place...): my $xmlout = do { local $SIG{__WARN__}=sub{}; XMLout(...) };

Minor edits for clarification.
